headline: From Thursday dev storage may move to a cooler tier without asking each time
permission: I send this card only because your organisation chose the optional standing-permission mode. Your FinOps lead and platform owner granted it, with your organisation's own role, to an identity of its own choosing: storage tier changes in development subscriptions, up to about €500 a month in Expected saving per change at the rates on your bill (a ceiling, not a forecast), until 12 March. It covers 3 of your resources and never a purchase. I hold no right to change Azure.
how: Each time it is used, the conditions are checked first and I tell you within minutes. Where Azure allows an undo, I offer it on a page where you sign in to Azure. I add each run to your weekly summary.
yourChoice: If you do not want it used on your resources, choose Pause changes here before Thursday. That stops this standing permission for those resources; it does not stop my suggestions.
whyYouGetThis: you own 3 resources in the development subscriptions this permission covers.
notificationText: From Thursday dev storage may move to a cooler tier without asking each time
